name: production-master
description: Thin client for the Production Master hosted incident-investigation service — start a run, follow its progress, read the report, and act on proposed changes from inside Claude Code. Connects to the hosted service's MCP endpoint; nothing runs on your machine.

api_token.title: Production Master access token
api_token.description: A personal access token from the Production Master console (Settings, then Access tokens). It is stored in your OS credential store and sent only to the Production Master service.
